jsonSchemaCredentialId.description: Credential type of the offer: the jsonSchemaCredentialId of a CredentialSchema for which the agent holds an active ISSUER Participant.

claims.description: Claim values of the offered credential. Any subset of the configured claims, at least one, each non-empty; an omitted claim is left out of the credential.

ttlSeconds.description: Lifetime of the credential in seconds, from 60 up to 31536000 (one year) for a credential registered on a status list, and up to 7776000 (90 days) for one that is not: nothing revokes such a credential, so this lifetime is its only bound.

statusListId.description: Status list of this agent that the credential is registered on, from createStatusList. Required for a revocable credential, together with statusListIndex.

statusListIndex.description: Index of the credential on that status list, from 0 to size - 1. The caller allocates the index; the agent refuses one that an earlier offer bound. Required whenever statusListId is present.

statusList.summary: Credential registered on a status list
